claim_ledger.requirement: Same employee/workplace and idempotency key with identical payload returns the same event; conflicting payload fails explicitly.
IN then OUT retains exact UTC integer milliseconds; no mutation of original event history.
Competing commands use explicit expected revision: stale revision conflicts. Pure tests prove conflict semantics only; actual DB concurrency remains W2/W3 integration evidence.
OUT without IN, repeated IN, missing OUT, reversed/zero duration, duplicate event IDs and overlapping intervals produce stable errors or blocking exceptions; never silently fabricate work.
Out-of-schedule, public-holiday and 22:00-06:00 local work are explicit exceptions, including intervals crossing midnight and local calendar boundaries.
Shop timezone is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; timestamps are raw UTC milliseconds; local time derives from explicit context without system clock or host timezone.
Six-hour and ten-hour approved shifts keep the whole duration including paid breaks; 59/60/61 second durations remain exact.
Only explicitly approved payable intervals appear in payable outputs. Full-time variance never emits automatic monetary deductions.

Snapshot construction rejects unresolved exceptions and unapproved/overlapping/out-of-period or mismatched employee/workplace segments. Supplied approval metadata is synthetic domain input, not authenticated authorization proof.
Reordering semantically unordered input records gives the same snapshot hash; changing an approved millisecond, classification or approver changes it. Snapshot is detached and immutable.
Attendance unit tests, payroll regressions, attendance-inclusive typecheck and scoped diff check pass.
claim_ledger.evidence: 63 tests /9 files; integrated typecheck; protected hashes; scoped diff check

limitations: Synthetic supplied approval metadata does not authenticate the owner.
Pure expected-revision behavior does not prove database concurrency or durable event persistence.
Kiosk, schedule repositories/commands, authenticated snapshot approval and app E2E are not run.
